name: Pactiv Evergreen - Cedar Rapids IA
type: Manufacturing Plant (Filling Equipment / carton filling machinery)

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (ROOFTOP, 41.95494,-91.678837, movedMeters 111) lands on a large industrial building at the SW corner of 6th St SW and Wilson Ave SW, Cedar Rapids — confirmed at satellite z16-z19. This is the Pactiv Evergreen / Evergreen Packaging Equipment facility (gable-top carton filling-equipment manufacture and 24/7 parts/service). The building appears to be multi-tenant — a Street View sign at the south parking lot reads 'ALTORFER' (a Caterpillar dealer), indicating shared occupancy of the industrial block.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site — no perimeter fence enclosing a controlled truck entrance. The building fronts directly on public streets with open parking lots and driveways; no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. truckGate = false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere on the site.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A modest dock/loading area is on the south/southeast face (visible z18-z19) — roughly 6-10 doors serving an equipment-manufacturing operation. Low-confidence count; banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer-parking stalls and effectively no trailers in the imagery — dropArea = NONE. This is an equipment plant, not a high-throughput freight facility.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Dock approach is a short paved apron off the building's parking lots — holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Cedar Rapids urban fabric — the site sits at a signalized 4-way intersection with residential neighborhoods on three sides and a city park to the northeast. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property (a former rail alignment runs near the west side but does not serve the building).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~17 acres for the parcel; the Pactiv operation may occupy only part of a shared multi-tenant block, so usable yard area is smaller. Flagged uncertain.
